name: Ethereal Ice Cathedral
description: A towering cathedral carved entirely from translucent blue ice, its spires catching the aurora above while delicate frost flowers bloom on its walls.
prompt: Majestic ice cathedral under a vibrant aurora borealis, walls and spires made of clear, faceted ice with subtle internal glow. Frost flowers and crystalline vines cling to arches. Reflections of the aurora dance on the icy floor. Wide perspective, ultra‑high detail, cold color palette with teal, violet, and emerald highlights. 8k, photorealistic.
caption: Where frozen silence sings with light. ❄️✨ #EtherealIceCathedral
